plugin.name: Runbook
plugin.description: Steps that run things, a contents that carries them out in order, and logs of each run.
field.text.placeholder: What this step does, what to look at
field.target.hint: An HTTP request, SQL query, command, script or prompt; empty for a step done by hand
field.inputs.hint: One per line: name = value; @step.value takes a value from an earlier step
field.compare.hint: One per line; = ≠ > < ≥ ≤ contains, empty, not empty
field.confirm.placeholder: Check the versions above, then continue
flow.alone: A flow contents belongs in a book (in place of its contents).
flow.empty: No steps yet: add step pages to the book.
flow.notRun: Not run yet: “Run” carries out the steps one after another.
flow.head: Run {n} · {operator} · {where}
flow.freshDone: The next “Run” starts a new log.
run.failed: Stopped at {step}: it failed. Fix it, then “Continue” runs it again.
run.alreadyDone: This run is complete: “Run” starts a new one.
step.last: Last time (in the current run log)
step.noFlow: This step is not in a book with a flow contents.
compare.noOperator: A line has no comparison (= ≠ > < ≥ ≤ contains, empty, not empty).
log.name: {book} · run {n}
log.head: Run {n} · {operator} · started {started}
log.none: Run logs are written by a flow contents.
logs.hint: The run logs of a book: open one to see what happened.
export.pickFolder: Choose a folder to export to, then export again.
